dct_creator_sm: Marshall, Joanne (Department of Population Medicine. Ontario Veterinary College. University of Guelph). ORCID: https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0235-2224
dct_description_sm: This study aimed to use focus groups to understand the motivations, perspectives, and sources of influence for dairy farmers to make culling decisions and complete management practices for these cows. A secondary objective was to explore farmers management of potential cull cows from described scenarios.
dct_title_s: Supplementary materials for: A focus group study investigating Ontario dairy farmers' attitudes toward and perspectives of cull cow management
